definition: The raw, unnormalized output scores produced by a neural network's final layer before being converted into probabilities (typically via softmax).
details: Logits are useful for various downstream operations like temperature scaling during sampling, since they represent relative preferences before normalization compresses them into a probability distribution.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. And that shape of the machine — Logits — is what makes everything else possible.
